Two quick asks so we can lock the right slot and make the session useful:

- From our discovery, two areas we should prioritize: data residency + inference latency on 16k context. I attached a one-pager and a proposed agenda.

Proposed slots (all listed in PDT — if you prefer ET, I’ve added equivalent times in parentheses):
1) Tue 2025-06-23 11:00 AM PDT (2:00 PM ET) — 60 min
2) Wed 2025-06-24 9:00 AM PDT (12:00 PM ET) — 60 min
3) Thu 2025-06-25 4:00 PM PDT (7:00 PM ET) — 60 min

If none of those work, please send 2-3 windows that do and I’ll push an invite with the correct join info and an ICS.

Attachments: [Attachment: Discovery-notes.pdf (PDF, 180KB)], [Attachment: Proposed-agenda.md (Markdown, 3KB)].

Thanks — I’ll hold the slots until I hear back.
